title: Place pending publish byte budgets on visible settings tab
summary: Move the Pending Publish autonomy byte-budget controls onto the visible Publish & Recovery Settings builder and make the visible inputs use GiB values.
reason: The prior exposure placed AutonomyPendingTotalReviewBytes and AutonomyPendingTotalBlockBytes on metadata page Advanced, but the current Settings UI has no Advanced tab. Operators need these launch-gate budgets in an existing visible workflow.
behavior_before: The pending-publish byte-budget keys were managed config metadata but pointed at a non-visible Advanced page and were not present in the static Publish & Recovery builder inputs.
behavior_after: The byte-budget keys now declare page Publish & Recovery / section Recovery Settings, render as GiB inputs in the visible Recovery Settings panel, convert GiB values to the byte-backed config keys when staging the Settings patch, and appear in the pending-publish builder guidance/docs/tests.
manual_validation: CONFIG_FIELD_DEFINITIONS spot-check shows AutonomyPendingTotalReviewBytes/AutonomyPendingTotalBlockBytes page Publish & Recovery section Recovery Settings - passed
Static check found settings-pending-review-budget-gib/settings-pending-block-budget-gib controls and bytes_gib conversion - passed
mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage - failed due unrelated empty high-risk MP-CHANGE-2026-0705-011 packet
rollback_plan: Remove the two pending-budget controls from the Publish & Recovery static HTML and pendingPublishSettingsBuilderFields, remove the bytes_gib conversion branch from the pending builder, restore the metadata page/section if needed, and revert the docs/generated-summary/test wording changes. The underlying config keys from MP-CHANGE-2026-0705-006 can remain managed but would no longer have visible builder controls.
notes: Move pending-publish autonomy byte budget controls from hidden Advanced metadata into the visible Publish & Recovery builder.
